verdict.rationale: Figma publishes an official MCP server. It has dedicated developer docs, a remote server option that works without the desktop app, and documented tools for reading design context, generating code, and writing native content back to the canvas. A probe also confirmed the official MCP docs are live. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent through it, and clarity on plan gating (pricing lists the MCP server alongside advanced Dev Mode).
